The '''2022 Mustafar Masters Series Event 1''' was an online six-player tournament on 15–16 October 2022, organized by [[Chris Gogolen]].<ref name="mms2022">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1390488#p1390488 Final standings], gogolen, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 October 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122230745/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1390488.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="mmssix">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1390438#p1390438 Six players, four games], gogolen, forum.starwarsccg.org (14 October 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122230745/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1390488.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="mmsonline">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1390473#p1390473 Round 1 pairings], gogolen, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 October 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122230745/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1390488.html Internet Archive].</ref> [[Tom Strother]] won the $400 prize.<ref name="mmswin">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1390630#p1390630 Tom won the $400 prize], gogolen, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 October 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122230745/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1390488.html Internet Archive].</ref>
